who: Mitch Kachun (Mitchell Alan Kachun), historian of African American history and public memory at Western Michigan; PhD history, Cornell, 1997.

Western Michigan’s repository identifies Mitch Kachun of its history department as author of Festivals of Freedom, and its published-book citation uses Mitchell A. Kachun.
Western Michigan’s retirement notice records a Cornell history doctorate, arrival in the history department in 2001, and teaching in African American and United States history.
